title: slugify leaves repeated and trailing dashes
prompt: slugify("  Hello,   World!  ") should produce "hello-world": collapse runs of separators into one dash and trim leading/trailing dashes. Accented Latin letters should be transliterated ("Crème brûlée" -> "creme-brulee").
acceptance: Runs of non-alphanumerics become a single dash
Accents are stripped via Unicode normalisation
